subject: Nazeby
text: Nazeby has 4980 HP and has no elemental weakness.

evidence.quote:
BOSS TIME: Nazeby
HP: 4980
WEAKNESS: None

subject: Nazeby
text: Against Nazeby, Lufia should cast Drain in the first round and Thunder subsequently, while Jerin uses Power Gourds and Trick on the Hero and Aguro, and uses Wind Flute or Boost for multi-target spell recovery.

evidence.quote:
Lufia should cast Drain during the first round,
then Thunder in each subsequent round.  Jerin should use Power Gourds on the
Hero and Aguro, then Trick to maintain their attack power.  When necessary, use 
the Wind Flute or cast Boost to keep your HP up against his multi-targeting
spells, but he should go down quickly.

subject: Dragon Egg Sidequest
text: The recommended level for the Dragon Shrine is 48.

evidence.quote:
DRAGON SHRINE [DRGN1]
Recommended Level: 48

subject: Alekia Castle
text: A chest containing a Dragon Egg is found in Alekia Castle by going up two flights of stairs to the roof, walking to the upper right corner, and descending two flights of stairs.

evidence.quote:
1) Alekia Castle.  Go up two flights of stairs to the roof.  Then, walk around 
to the upper right corner and down two flights of stairs to find the chest.

subject: Northwest Tower
text: A chest containing a Dragon Egg is on the roof of Northwest Tower reached by circling clockwise, taking the stairs, entering two right doors, and taking the stairs left to the top.

evidence.quote:
2) Northwest Tower.  Walk clockwise around the perimeter and take the stairs.
Enter the right door, the next right door, and up the stairs.  Go left to the 
stairs to the roof where you will find the chest at the top.

subject: Belgen
text: A chest containing a Dragon Egg is located in the cave to the northeast in Belgen.

evidence.quote: 3) Belgen.  Walk northeast into the cave to find the chest.

subject: Southwest Cave
text: A chest containing a Dragon Egg is found in the Southwest Cave by walking down the steps, left, and down to the next steps.

evidence.quote:
4) Southwest Cave.  Take the steps down, left, and down to the steps to the
chest.

subject: Cave To Marse
text: A chest containing a Dragon Egg is inside the small cave located northeast of the Tower of Light.

evidence.quote:
5) Cave To Marse.  This is the small cave northeast of the Tower of Light with
a single chest.

subject: Elba Island Cave
text: A chest containing a Dragon Egg is located on the left side of the lower level in Elba Island Cave, accessible by climbing down all ladders.

evidence.quote:
6) Elba Island Cave.  Warp back to Marse and the cave is due north.  Climb down
all the ladders and the chest is on the left of the lower level.

subject: Under Ring Island
text: A chest containing a Dragon Egg is reached in the southwest cave of Soshette by riding the current to the main area, going up past the first intersection, heading northeast at the second intersection, and riding the current.

evidence.quote:
7) Under Ring Island.  Warp back to Soshette, and enter the southwest cave.
Ride the current to the main area.  Go up, past the first intersection, up to
the next.  Then, head northeast, and ride the current to the chest.

subject: Oil Cave
text: A chest containing a Dragon Egg is found in the Oil Cave by climbing down all ladders in the large room to the lower left steps, then crossing the bridge on the upper plateau.

evidence.quote:
8) Oil Cave.  Follow the path to the large room.  Climb down all the ladders to
the steps in the lower left corner.  Stay on the upper plateau and proceed
across the bridge to the chest.

subject: Dragon Shrine
text: Exchanging the 8 Dragon Eggs at the Dragon Shrine grants another Might Shield, causing the eggs to scatter one last time.

evidence.quote:
Return to the Dragon Shrine and exchange the 8 Dragon Eggs for another Might
Shield (equip on Hero).  They will scatter one last time to 8 more chests:

subject: Sheran Castle
text: A chest containing a Dragon Egg is found on the right side of the throne room in Sheran Castle after climbing the stairs to the roof.

evidence.quote:
1) Sheran Castle.  Climb the stairs to the roof, enter the throne room, and the
chest is on the right.

subject: East Cave
text: A chest containing a Dragon Egg is the first chest seen inside East Cave.

evidence.quote: 2) East Cave.  The first chest you see.  Can't miss it.

subject: Lyden
text: A chest containing a Dragon Egg is downstairs beneath the kitchen in Lyden, reached by walking counter-clockwise around the hill.

evidence.quote:
3) Lyden.  Walk counter-clockwise around the hill to walk up to the kitchen.
Head down the steps to find the chest.

subject: Old Cave
text: A chest containing a Dragon Egg is located below a ladder in the upper right corner of the main area on the 7th level of the Old Cave.

evidence.quote:
4) Old Cave 7th Level.  Climb the ladder to the door to the main area.  Walk
around to the stairs in the upper right corner.  Climb down the ladder to the
chest below.

subject: Purple Newt Cave
text: A chest containing a Dragon Egg is located in the Purple Newt Cave by going right, down a ladder, right, down a ladder, right, and down.

evidence.quote:
5) Purple Newt Cave.  Go right, down the ladder, right, down the ladder, right
and down where you should see the chest.

subject: North Glasdar Cave
text: A chest containing a Dragon Egg is reached in North Glasdar Cave by descending three ladders in the left room to flip a switch up, then taking the right door path to a warp point.

evidence.quote:
6) North Glasdar Cave.  Follow the path to the steps to the basement.  Enter
the left door and climb down three ladders to the switch room.  Flip the
switch up and walk back to the room with two doors.  Take the right door around
the path to the warp point to the chest.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: A chest containing a Dragon Egg is found in the Cave to Glasdar Tower by descending two ladders, passing the swamp to the right, going up to the main area, heading left past two ladders, and climbing up two ladders.

evidence.quote:
7) Cave to Glasdar Tower.  Climb down two ladders, right past the swamp, and up
to the stairs to the main area.  Go left, past the first two ladder, then up 
two ladders to the chest.

subject: Glasdar Tower
text: A chest containing a Dragon Egg is located in the treasure trove of Glasdar Tower, accessed by stepping on the two right switches in the switch room.

evidence.quote:
8) Glasdar Tower.  Make your way up to the switch room.  Step on the right two
switches.  This will lead you back to the treasure trove, where one of the
chests contains the final Dragon Egg.

subject: Dragon Shrine
text: For the final wish at the Dragon Shrine, players can choose a third Might Shield or the Might Bow.

evidence.quote:
For your final wish, I'd still recommend going for a third Might Shield (equip
on Aguro).  Granted, the Might Bow is kind of nice, but at this point, she
really shouldn't be attacking very much anyway.

subject: Fortress of Doom

subject: Fortress of Doom

evidence.quote:
Open the chest in the room which contains a SPELL POTION.  Leave the room, then

subject: Fortress of Doom

Along the straight-forward path to the next floor are two enclosed rooms.  In

chests which also contain 3 MIRACLES.

subject: Gades

evidence.quote:
Keep everyone's HP above 300, so you can
survive his Destroy attack.  Jerin's Champion spell is great for healing up

subject: Amon
text: Amon has 4000 HP and is weak to Fire.

evidence.quote:
BOSS TIME: Amon
HP: 4000
WEAKNESS: Fire

subject: Amon
text: Against Amon, Jerin should continuously cast Mirror on every character in a cycle to reflect all incoming spells while the Hero casts Drain and attacks with Aguro.

evidence.quote:
Since he mostly casts spells, have Jerin cast Mirror on everybody.  She should
cast it every round on each character in a cycle, even if they haven't lost
their Mirror yet.  This should guarantee that none of Amon's spells will ever 
get through.  As usual, have the Hero cast Drain, then have Aguro and he attack
every round.  I wouldn't even bother using Power Gourds or Trick.

evidence.quote:
FINAL BOSS TIME: Guard Daos
HP: 6500
WEAKNESS: Thunder

subject: Guard Daos
text: Guard Daos uses Flood and Figual, which confuses the entire party; Jerin should maintain Mirror on party members, use an Elven Bow on allies or Shriek to cure confusion, while Lufia casts Thunder.

evidence.quote:
Guard Daos only has two attacks: Flood and Figual.  Figual can
inflict confuse on your entire party.  Thus, it is imperative that you cast and
maintain Mirror on as many party members as possible.

If too many characters become confused, Jerin can
safely use the Elven Bow to attack your own party and snap them all out of it.
If it's just one character, then use a Shriek to do so.  Otherwise, Aguro and
the Hero should attack every round, while Lufia casts Thunder for massive
